mustFix.problem: Labels collide and clip: the '03 Ice shield' chip covers the 'ice shield' callout whose tail 'el' spills past the frame's right edge; the drag line cuts 'water ledys on top'; 'fascia' collides with the frame's bottom edge.
mustFix.fix: Delete the in-drawing 'ice shield' callout (the chip names it), move 'water leads on top' above the membrane line left of the 40% mark, raise 'fascia' 16px clear of the frame, and keep every SVG label at least 24px from the compare line's travel range at both viewports.

elevate.move: Make the drawings behave like the photo packet the thesis promises: each detail frame becomes a packet sheet with a consistent title strip (layer number, layer name, 'checked before covering'), a line-draw clip reveal in stack order, and detail 05 plus the drip edge redrawn to the density of the deck and felt frames.

Make the stack the motion idea: as each layer band enters, its segment slides in from the right and locks onto the sticky card while the band's dash bar fills in step, and reuse exactly that slide-and-lock in the estimator when the job changes, so the roof builds itself as you scroll and the tool pulls out the layers it touches.
